name: nutrition_totals
description: Totals of energy and nutrients from a food table given in the input (amounts per 100 g) and the grams of each item, per item, in total and per serving, with the percentage of reference intakes: the adult reference intakes of Regulation (EU) No 1169/2011 Annex XIII (energy 8400 kJ / 2000 kcal, fat 70 g, saturates 20 g, carbohydrate 260 g, sugars 90 g, protein 50 g, salt 6 g, and the vitamin and mineral NRVs) by default, or values given in the input. Exact arithmetic; every output carries a disclaimer.

foods.description: Food name -> {nutrient key: amount per 100 g}; Annex XIII keys use its units (g, mg, ug, kJ, kcal)

catalog.source: Regulation (EU) No 1169/2011 on the provision of food information to consumers, Annex XIII (reference intakes), transcribed by tools/catalog/data/nutrition_totals.py from EUR-Lex CELEX 32011R1169
